title: BenchmarkService
responsibility: Coordinates benchmark validation, execution and result rendering for the CLI.

inputs.name: BenchmarkService.execute.operation
inputs.description: Validation, execution or persisted-results operation selected by the CLI.

inputs.name: BenchmarkService.execute.target
inputs.description: Definition JSON path for validation or execution, or a persisted run ID for results.

inputs.name: BenchmarkService.execute.options
inputs.description: JSON output selection and optional reproducible trial-order seed.

outputs.name: BenchmarkService.execute
outputs.description: Prints the selected benchmark operation; unsuccessful runs retain a nonzero exit status.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Reports an invalid operation, definition, persisted run or provider failure as a CLI error.
